answer_1.quote: Reading order detection, aiming to capture the word sequence which can be naturally comprehended by human readers, is a fundamental task for visually-rich document understanding.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates a sequence of word indices in reading order from document images, given tokens with their bounding boxes.

answer_2.quote: We report Average Page-level BLEU in our experiments. The page-level BLEU refers to the micro-average precision of n-gram overlaps within a page. The ARD score is proposed to evaluate the difference between reordered sequences.

answer_4.quote: Since the ReadingBank is generated in an automated manner, we further conduct human evaluation to study the dataset quality. We sample 20 pages from the ReadingBank and compare them with the human annotations.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation compares the generated reading order from ReadingBank with human annotations using BLEU and ARD scores.
